questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems recognize your brand as authoritative, relevant and trustworthy, which covers content strategy, entity optimization, reputation signals and technical implementation [6]. Joe describes GEO as broader and longer term than AEO, focused on making a brand a recognized entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. It also depends on being technically accessible, since AI search tools discover content through the same basic mechanisms as traditional crawlers [8].

questions.answer: Keyword research now centers on user intent and conversational queries rather than exact-match terms or search volume alone [4]. Start by focusing on the specific problems your audience wants to solve, and use tools such as SEMrush's Keyword Magic Tool to help identify the intent behind searches [4]. Look for intent classification, SERP feature presence, related keyword clusters, and seasonal intent shifts, and check the "People Also Ask" section and your existing content's user behavior data [3][6]. Joe also suggests building topic coverage around related subtopics, since AI engines understand context well [7]. For more, see the guide at /blog/keyword-research-in-2025-beyond-traditional-seo
